summary: The 2006 Souten no Ken TV anime (26 eps) is a linear, essentially unabridged adaptation of manga chapters 1-88 = tankobon volumes 1-8, in running order, with no filler and no arc reordering (animefillerlist types all 26 episodes 'Manga Canon'; our rows already type all 26 canon). Chapter space confirmed as the 260-chapter numbering our entry uses (ja.wikipedia infobox 全260話; MangaUpdates latest_chapter 260; MangaDex indexes 1-260 with no gaps across 22 volumes). MangaDex's volume aggregate gives exact volume boundaries (v1 1-10, v2 11-22, v3 23-33, v4 34-44, v5 45-55, v6 56-66, v7 67-77, v8 78-88), which is what makes the standing pin checkable: en.wikipedia and hokuto.fandom both say the anime 'truncates the story at the end of Vol. 8', vol 8 ends at chapter 88, and MangaUpdates states the anime range explicitly as 'Vol 1, Chap 1' to 'Vol 8, Chap 88' — so the unverified MU pin ep 26 -> ch 88 is CORRECT and now corroborated three ways plus by content (ch 88 is titled 'memories unlocked', which is exactly how ep 26 ends: Yu Ling's memory returns). Per-episode anchors were derived from a strong structural fact: almost every episode title is lifted verbatim from a manga chapter title (ep 1 = ch 1 賞金首・閻王, ep 5 = ch 10 上海に立つ, ep 14 = ch 41 運命の旅, ep 21 = ch 71 燃えたぎる対峙, ep 22 = ch 72 張太炎の奥義, ep 25 = ch 85 祝宴と銃声), and the resulting spans reproduce hokuto.fandom's independently-published arc-to-episode table (ch 1-9 = eps 1-4, ch 10-41 = eps 5-14, ch 42-78 = eps 15-23, ch 79+ = eps 24-26) exactly at all three internal boundaries. Structure note: the OVA component (AniList 3864, 'DVD episodes') is mapped in our entry to eps 23-26, but the four never-broadcast episodes are production numbers 16-18 and 21 (they are TV episodes withheld from terrestrial airing, later shown on Animax/Family Gekijo/MONDO TV); our row 1-26 order and titles already match ja.wikipedia's canonical 各話リスト, so no anchor numbering is affected.

anchors.note: Ep title 賞金首・閻王 = ch 1's title; ep 2's title is ch 2's title, so ep 1 stops at the (extra-long Bunch debut) ch 1. Anime adds an original 1932 wedding-day cold open.
Ep title 江胡の義気 = ch 2's title; ends on the Puyi confrontation, matching ch 4 'the puppet emperor' / ch 5 'unforgivable humiliation'. Ep 3's title is ch 6.
Ep title 北斗を継ぐ者 = ch 6's title; Li Yong-Jian's rescue + Jin Ke-Rong flashback match ch 7 'Li Yong-Jian's tears' and ch 8 'city of evil'.

ARC BOUNDARY. hokuto.fandom: 'Japan Arc (chapters 1-9, episodes 1-4)'; ep title 蒼天に願え = ch 9's title. One chapter stretched by anime-original padding (ja.wikipedia notes the added scene of Ramon cycling to the port to see Kenshiro off).

START is doubly confirmed: hokuto.fandom puts the Ling Wang arc at ch 10 / ep 5, and ep title 上海に立つ = ch 10's title. END inferred: ep closes on Ye's account of the Game of Death, i.e. before ch 13 (ep 6's title chapter).
Ep title 虐殺の処刑遊戯 = ch 13's title; the confessional scene = ch 14 'a shameless confession', the Goran bout = ch 15 'a spectacular show'.
Ep title 激突 = ch 16's title; Goran's Muay Thai hold = ch 17 'Goran's secret technique', Goran's collapse = ch 19 'the hour of victory'.
Ep title 地獄の神に祈れ = ch 20's title; the revelation that Pan is alive with his legs eaten by rats = ch 21 'cruel torture'.
Ep title 血塗られた宿命ゆえに = ch 23's title; Boss Weng's betrayal = ch 24, Ling Wang's arrival in Shanghai = ch 25 'a stealthy shadow'. END 26 vs 27 is the one soft edge in this stretch (+/-1).
Ep title 北斗同士の戦い = ch 28's title (the Kenshiro/Ling Wang draw at Mei Yu's party); ep 11's title is ch 29, so END is 28.
Ep title 龍に問え = ch 29's title; the Gongzhou Citadel rescue = ch 30 'save your pengyou', Wu's death in the oil vat = ch 31 'dance of death'.
Ep title 復活の狼煙 = ch 34's title (the staged funeral and Pan's return as Qing Bang leader); ch 32 'for the restoration of the Qing Bang' opens the episode's material.
The Kenshiro/Ling Wang duel: ch 35 'fist of madness', ch 36 'after the madness' (= the English ep title 'At The End of Madness'), ch 37 = the ja ep title 魔道に落つ.
ARC BOUNDARY. hokuto.fandom: 'Ling Wang Arc (chapters 10-41, episodes 5-14)'; ep title 運命の旅 is exactly ch 41's title ('el viaje del destino'). Ling Wang dies; Kenshiro and Pan begin the takeover.

START 42 is the hokuto.fandom arc boundary (Zhang Taiyan arc, ch 42-78 = eps 15-23); the episode's first half (Pan purging Carnet and the traitor, Kenshiro killing Tian Xue-Fang) = ch 42-43, and ep title 美しき馬賊 = ch 44's title (Li Xiu-Bao's introduction).

Ep title 安息の地を求めて = ch 47's title; de Guise's Shangri-La plan = ch 46, Zhang Tai-Yan's carousing = ch 48 'heroes love beauty', Sophie's returning memory = ch 50 'the return of memory' (the episode's closing beat).
Ep title 死の宣告!堕天掌 takes its first half from ch 52 'the death sentence'; the ambulance ambush and Sophie's death are ch 51-52. Ep 18 opens on her funeral.

Kenshiro hunting Tai-Yan at the Taohua Zhang = ch 53 'in search of Zhang Tai-Yan' through ch 56. Softest boundary in the run: ch 57 ('the man behind the Hong Hua Hui') could belong here rather than to ep 19 (+/-1).
Ep title 毅然たる献花 = ch 61's title; the bandit trains = ch 58, the bus rammed into the bandits = ch 59 'bloody bus stop', Kenshiro recognising Li Xiu-Bao as Yu-Ling = ch 62 'a nostalgic fragrance'.
Ep title 運命の悪戯 = ch 65's title; the crab that triggers Yu-Ling's buried memory closes the episode = ch 66 'tears of remembrance'. Ep 21 opens on ch 67 'a trusted interpreter'.
Ep title 燃えたぎる対峙 is exactly ch 71's title; Kenshiro's interpreter cover = ch 67, Pu the Mole's plague-flea plot and pursuit = ch 68-70, the burning ship = ch 71.

Ep title 張太炎の奥義 is exactly ch 72's title (Bakuryu Yoentotsu); ch 73-75 carry the exchange to the standoff. The Goshamonto rushing in / de Guise blocking them at the very end of the episode is the head of ch 76, which ep 23 then plays out.

ARC BOUNDARY. hokuto.fandom: 'Zhang Taiyan Arc (chapters 42-78, episodes 15-23)'. Ep title 忘れ得ぬ痛み = ch 77's title; the Goshamonto's true mission = ch 76; Tai-Yan's resolve and de Guise's cross-scar = ch 78 'Tai-Yan's resolution', the last chapter before vol 8's Zhang Lieshan material.

START 79 is doubly confirmed (hokuto.fandom arc start ch 79 at ep 24, and ep title 深く強き想い = ch 79's title). The Bund photograph = ch 81 'a familiar image', the old house/church = ch 82 'a place full of memories', Kenshiro's denial = ch 83 'a flower that must not be touched'. END 83 vs 82 is soft (+/-1).

Ep title 祝宴と銃声 is exactly ch 85's title ('un festin y un disparo'), and the episode's closing beat IS that chapter: the banquet for Li Xiu-Bao's pardon followed by Chen shooting Pan Guang-Lin. Bounded on the far side by the fixed ep-26 END of 88.

EXISTING MU PIN VERIFIED, NOT REPAIRED. MangaUpdates states the anime range as 'Vol 1, Chap 1' -> 'Vol 8, Chap 88'; en.wikipedia and hokuto.fandom independently say the series 'truncates the story at the end of Vol. 8'; MangaDex's volume aggregate shows vol 8 = ch 78-88, so 'end of vol 8' resolves to ch 88. Content check: ch 88 is titled 'memories unlocked', which is precisely the finale's climax (Yu-Ling's memory returns in the jazz hall). Reader continues at ch 89.

annotations.note: Japan arc is only 9 chapters across 4 episodes (2.25 ch/ep vs 3.4 for the series); the anime pads with original material - e.g. ja.wikipedia records an anime-only scene of Ramon cycling to the port to see Kenshiro off, and the Aya Kitaoji subplot is expanded.

Finale is the only episode whose title (より良い明日へ) is NOT a manga chapter title - it is an anime-original wrap on ch 86-88. The story is cut off, not concluded: the manga continues at ch 89 with Yu-Ling taking over the Qing Bang and the Zhang Lieshan arc running to ch 104.

structure.notes: 26 episodes, single cour, our rows 1-26 already match ja.wikipedia's canonical 各話リスト in production order and titles - no renumbering needed. COMPONENT MISMATCH: our components map AniList 3864 ('Souten no Ken (DVD episodes)', 4 eps, kind=ova) onto OUR eps 23-26, but the four episodes that never aired terrestrially are production numbers 16, 17, 18 and 21 (ja.wikipedia: 地上波では全26話のうち22話が放送された（未放送話数は、16 - 18、21話）; en.wikipedia: 'four of the episodes (16-18, and 21) did not air during the original run'). Our rows 16/17/18/21 are exactly the four with no air_date, which corroborates it. They are withheld TV episodes (later broadcast on Animax, Family Gekijo and MONDO TV, and on the R2 DVDs), not OVAs - the season/ova split at 22|23 is an artefact of AniList's entry split and should not be read as a story boundary. CHAPTER SPACE: 260 chapters = our entry's space (ja.wikipedia infobox 全260話; MangaUpdates latest_chapter 260; MangaDex 1-260 continuous). ja.wikipedia's lead text instead says 全255話 serialized in Weekly Comic Bunch - a 5-chapter discrepancy against its own infobox; every numbering-bearing source (MU, MangaDex) uses 260, and all three arc boundaries line up in that space, so 260 is correct for us. VOLUME BOUNDARIES (from MangaDex aggregate, none were stored): v1 1-10, v2 11-22, v3 23-33, v4 34-44, v5 45-55, v6 56-66, v7 67-77, v8 78-88, v9 89-99, v10 100-110, v11 111-122, v12 123-134, v13 135-146, v14 147-158, v15 159-171, v16 172-184, v17 185-197, v18 198-209, v19 210-222, v20 223-232, v21 233-248, v22 249-260. ADAPTATION SHAPE: linear and near-complete over ch 1-88; animefillerlist types all 26 episodes 'Manga Canon' (agrees with our stored row types); no rearrangement, no side stories, no skipped chapters found. Max adapted chapter = 88; honest continue_from_chapter = 89 (corroborated by wheredoestheanimeleaveoff.com as a cross-check only).

flags_for_sean: COMPONENT RANGE LOOKS WRONG (not an anchor field, so no repair emitted): component 2 (AniList 3864, kind=ova, 'Souten no Ken (DVD episodes)') is stored as OUR eps 23-26. The four DVD-only/never-terrestrially-aired episodes are actually production numbers 16, 17, 18 and 21 - the four rows in our table with no air_date. Sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%92%BC%E5%A4%A9%E3%81%AE%E6%8B%B3 and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fist_of_the_Blue_Sky . They are also arguably not 'ova' at all (they later aired on Animax/Family Gekijo/MONDO TV). Anchors are unaffected because the row order is already correct.

MU PIN ep 26 -> ch 88 IS CORRECT - verify-only, no value change. Recommend re-tiering that row from 'mu' to 'manual' when the enriched fields (start_chapter 86, chapters_adapted 86-88, volume 8) are applied, per the hikaru lesson: a derivation-tier row loses repairs on the next MU re-derive.

ja.wikipedia contradicts itself on chapter count: lead says 全255話, infobox says 全260話. We use 260 (matches MU latest_chapter and MangaDex's continuous 1-260 index, and all three hokuto.fandom arc boundaries resolve consistently in that space). Worth knowing if a future source quotes 255.

Per-episode splits between the title-matched chapters are derivations, not stated mappings. The four boundaries at eps 4/14/23/24 are independently published by hokuto.fandom and match exactly; the softest internal edges (flagged in-note) are ep 9 END (26 vs 27), ep 18 END (56 vs 57), ep 22/23 (whether ch 76 opens at the tail of ep 22) and ep 24 END (83 vs 82).

No Japanese-language chapter title list was reachable (mangahot.jp / k-manga / mechacomic are all JS-rendered, comics.org returns 403). Chapter titles used for the content matching are the MangaDex es-la index, cross-checked against the Japanese EPISODE titles from ja.wikipedia - the matches are unambiguous (e.g. 祝宴と銃声 = ch 85 'un festin y un disparo', 燃えたぎる対峙 = ch 71 'el ardiente enfrentamiento'), but a native-title list would harden eps 7, 13 and 18.
